| Reason code | Kind | Clause | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `no_low_class_matched` | informational | §2.2 (fall-through) | None of the deterministic Low classes (§2.2.3, §2.2.4, §2.2.7, docs-only) applied; classifier fell through to LLM evaluation. |
| `prod_source_modified` | informational | §2.1 M7 (informational) | At least one file is non-doc, non-test, non-IaC — i.e. application source code was modified. |
| `2.2.6_logical_extension` — `The change is a non-destructive, function-preserving fix that adds a boolean parameter to an existing internal helper to conditionally skip key transformations for merchant metadata, reusing all existing code paths without touching auth, persistence, external integrations, or new abstractions.` | classifying | §2.2.6 | Sonnet 4.6 evaluator promoted minor → low: the change reuses existing code paths and does not cross a trust boundary. |

**Kinds:**
- `classifying` — this rule contributed to the chosen tier.
- `informational` — context only; did not by itself decide the tier.

See [issue #3](https://github.com/cko-core-platform/cko-agent-wall-e/issues/3) for the proposal to formalise this map as Appendix A of the standards doc.
